title: upstream crosslink: session status human and JSON paths are independent hand-written renderers
description: Upstream finding / absorption proposal for dollspace-gay/crosslink, 2026-07-20. Observation: session status composes its human output line-by-line (session.rs:185-231) and its JSON separately (session.rs:160-182) — duplicated logic, divergence-prone. The vsdd statusline design's one-computation-N-renderings shape (single snapshot acquisition, pure renderers per form, display truncation never in the machine form) is offered as an absorption candidate when the toolkit ships it.
